name: io.github.DSHCorrectover/agent-runtime-guard
title: Agent Runtime Guard — CCS Runtime Evidence
description: Runtime evidence layer for AI agents: block destructive commands, credential theft, SSRF and prompt injection in real time; verify tool calls against 7 CCS dimensions; issue Ed25519 tamper-evident receipts; and localize exactly which fields differ between two artifacts as RFC 6901 JSON-Pointers. Zero runtime dependencies, fail-closed by default.
